## Paris to Lisbon 5-Day Trip Plan

A relaxed 5-day city break with one museum day, one food-first day, and one coastal walk fits your budget well. I’m assuming mid-range 3-star lodging, public transit, and a mix of casual meals plus one nicer dinner.

## Day-by-Day Itinerary and Cost Plan

### Day 1: Tue, 14 Apr — Travel + Easy Lisbon Evening
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/airplane.svg
- Morning: Fly Paris to Lisbon; check in and rest after arrival.
- Afternoon: Light stroll in Baixa and Praça do Comércio.
- Dinner: Simple Portuguese meal near your hotel.
- Estimated cost for 2: Transport **EUR 180**, Lodging **EUR 120**, Meals **EUR 60**.

### Day 2: Wed, 15 Apr — Museum Day in Belém
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Museu Nacional do Azulejo or MAAT, depending on your interest.
- Afternoon: Belém Tower area and Jerónimos Monastery exterior walk.
- Dinner: Casual seafood or grilled chicken in central Lisbon.
- Estimated cost for 2: Transport **EUR 12**, Lodging **EUR 120**, Meals **EUR 70**, Museum tickets **EUR 25**.

### Day 3: Thu, 16 Apr — Food-Focused Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- Morning: Breakfast pastries and coffee, then Time Out Market.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/8/83/Lobster%2C_Time_Out_Market_Lisboa_%2850661858143%29.jpg Alt=Morning: Breakfast pastries and coffee, then Time Out Market, Lisbon, Portugal
- Afternoon: Food tour in Chiado/Alfama or self-guided tasting stops.
- Dinner: Traditional tascas, with room for wine and dessert.
- Estimated cost for 2: Transport **EUR 10**, Lodging **EUR 120**, Meals **EUR 110**, Tastings/tour **EUR 40**.

### Day 4: Fri, 17 Apr — Coastal Walk Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- Morning: Train to Cascais and walk the seafront promenade.
- Afternoon: Continue to Boca do Inferno and relax by the coast.
- Dinner: Back in Lisbon for a low-key dinner.
- Estimated cost for 2: Transport **EUR 18**, Lodging **EUR 120**, Meals **EUR 70**.

### Day 5: Sat, 18 Apr — Slow Morning + Return
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg
- Morning: Late breakfast and final neighborhood walk.
- Afternoon: Airport transfer and return to Paris.
- Dinner: In transit or after arrival, depending on flight time.
- Estimated cost for 2: Transport **EUR 180**, Lodging **EUR 0**, Meals **EUR 40**.

## Budget Breakdown for 2 Adults

| Category | Estimated Total |
|---|---:|
| Transport | EUR 400 |
| Lodging | EUR 480 |
| Meals | EUR 350 |
| Museum + activities | EUR 65 |
| Coastal day extras | EUR 40 |
| Buffer for small overruns | EUR 65 |
| Total | **EUR 1,400** |

### Best-Fit Trip Notes
- This plan stays right at your **EUR 1,400** cap.
- The biggest variable is flights; booking early is the main way to protect the budget.
- If you want more comfort, reduce one paid activity and keep meals more casual.

## Rainy-Day Backup Plan

### Rainy Day Swap: Indoor Lisbon Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/umbrella.svg
- Morning: National Tile Museum or Calouste Gulbenkian Museum.
- Afternoon: Tram or metro ride to covered cafés, bookstores, and shopping arcades.
- Dinner: Long lunch or early dinner at a cozy tasca.
- Cost impact: Usually **similar to the museum day**, with transport still low and no need for extra activity spend.
